Minutes of previous meeting were confirmed and signed
after the following paragraph, inadvertently omitted,
was inserted. 'Mr.Yelland reported that, since
gardeners could not be obtained for Vaucluse Park
despite several advertisements both in the Herald
and Wentworth Courier, he was of the opinion that
the wages paid by the Trust were not big enough an
inducement for this type of staff. It was decided
that the Secretary obtain from the Woollahra Council
the rates of pay for its gardening staff. The
proximity of the Council to Vaucluse House might
have an adverse effect on staff recruitment by Trust,
if the Council was offering higher rates of pay.
Furthermore it was decided that the President get in
touch with the Service,after obtaining this
information from the Woollahra Council, and explain
the difficulties the Trust has in hiring gardeners,
at the same time requesting permission for an
increase in line with rates paid by the Council.'
